MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Reusable cable ties fit my desk setup because I have recently added Ethernet cables and other wiring, and I want to keep those cords organized while still being able to rearrange them.",
    "A USB flash drive feels useful for moving files between my laptop and Raspberry Pi projects. Portable backup storage also interests me, although I have not decided how much capacity I need."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The full-size SD card misses the physical format I need: my recent memory-card purchases were microSD, so a similar storage purpose does not make this card interchangeable.",
    "The HDMI cable repeats something I already have without addressing a new need, while the optical cable and USB-C audio adapter assume connections I have not needed.",
    "Laptop RAM requires a compatibility check and a reason to upgrade, and the internal desktop hard drive does not fit my current laptop and Raspberry Pi projects. The earbuds also feel less relevant than desk accessories right now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been treated as a broad need for more cables, audio accessories, and storage, even when their specific uses do not match my setup.",
    "Having bought a cable or headphones before seems to be taken as a reason to buy another, without distinguishing an accessory that adds something useful from one that duplicates what I have."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Ethernet cables, headphone mount, and cleaning equipment point toward organizing and maintaining my desk, which makes reusable cable ties especially relevant.",
    "The exact fit matters: microSD versus full-size SD, laptop versus desktop hardware, and the ports my devices actually support.",
    "I am more interested in accessories that support my existing setup than upgrades that require an unconfirmed problem or compatibility assumption. Backup capacity is also something I would need to establish before choosing a drive."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in practical computer accessories but often missed the specific connections, compatibility, and current needs that make an accessory useful to me."
}
